translation.name: Nzryrngrkxtr Kc Ate Rut x Sam

content.text: Lalztqmamu x xlrmamu natqnge, nimu neidung mz nrlc tulvzo,
Kxmule-esz' nimu kxnzetung, leplz txneng, bcnyrng, x kxtrnzrngiscung.
Murde natqnge otxpx,
X alvztr-ngrne nzyrplapxngr,
Mz nzpipx-krnge natq lrtzlvz ngrgung.
Murde nayokaetipxx drtwr ngrdr mz nabz nenge.
Kxmule-esz' kxpux mz nztu-ngalelvzkr enqmi rngeng ninge,
A' trmwxlrwxu.
Murde kxdrka'ngr lcng nzabrtrpzlr drtwrdr mz trau,
X nzglqpx-lzbqng mz nzngini-krdr bcnyrng.
A' trpnzngr kxrkrlz nzxpepx-krde nzlu-krde esz'-krde.
Murde ncblo trtakitrdeu nzkapx-krde narncbr ngr nzlu-alongr kx yrlq Gct,
Kxmule-esz' ka-atwrnr-ngrde trau x dztudeng amrlx.
Murde rblx nzxpe-krde da kx na-arlapxle nide mz gq.
Leplz amrlx sa nabzng, kxmule-esz' kxnzyrplapxng o kxnzngqngung.
X dztudrng amrlx sa nabzszbzlr mz kzdung kz leplz.
X kxmule-esz' mzli ka nzrnginyzng drtc',
A' gq lrdr dela nangipe ma nyzdr mz nzmnc-alope-krdr elr.
Da amrlx kcng tqmatq mz drtwrdr sa nayrkrpx-kzng.
Leplz sa nabzng da kc tzwai animol amrlx.
Lrpzki r kxnzngqngung kcng tzabrtrlr drtwrdr mz nidr esz'-krdr x mz dztudrng,
Yrkrtxpxpwz mz nzbzngr.
Apule kx nzbzngr nide kxetu rdr kc tqmailzle nidr mz gq lrdr,
Mz nzapu-krdr sip.
X kxnztubqng sa navzneng wq mrkc tzyrtzmqngr namz ngrdr.
X mz nzmibi-krdr, nzyc-rlrubzng mz ma nyzdr.
A' Gct sa naxpetrle ninge mz zmatq ngr nzbzngr,
Mz nzarlapx-krde ninge mz gq.
Bzkq nabzmu talvzo mz nzmc-krmu bcnyrng,
X nzkqlunepxkr dztudrng.
Murde rblx nzrtwzmingr dztung mz nzbzngr.
Dztung la tqyc, a' nrkrdrtq la namibi.
Kxmule-esz' bcnyrng nzabrtz-zvzng mzli kc tzlube-ngrdr,
X nzamatq leplz nidr murde sc tzakqlunepx-zvzlr dztudrng,
A' sa navzo-kzng mz gq, da kc tzwai melrmqdrng,
Mz nzmnc-alo-krdr mz nzlo.
Da amrlx kcng tqmatq mz drtwrdr mane x nardr tryrplatrpwzu.
Leplz sa nabzng da kc tzwai animol amrlx.
